subagent_reports.architecture_assessment: Five sourced opportunities identified across the six reconcile components. Two are acceptance-criteria gaps that would leave the change unverifiable or incomplete as currently scoped (C1: validation gate is structurally unsatisfiable on a >budget store because adv_doctor has no budget override and budget_exceeded forces canonical_projection_consistent=false; C3: migration completion is blocked by a failed.length===0 marker gate that re-invocation alone cannot clear). Two are overlooked in-repo proven patterns that reduce risk and effort (C2: historical-repair's seed-validation+readback+lock idempotency shape, critical for a non-git/no-backup target store; C4: convergeEpicMembership as the post-reconstruction verification primitive). One is a reuse opportunity avoiding a parallel census/marker (C5). No candidate duplicates the three prior considerations: C2 is pattern-level reuse of a module the prior-consideration dismissed only on target-grounds (archive-delta/spec vs store envelopes); C4 reuses a verification primitive, not the top-down convergence direction that fixEpicMembershipConvergence owns. All evidence is file:line verified; lgrep symbol indices were stale for projection-health.ts and historical-repair.ts (byte/line mismatch), so all material claims were re-verified via direct read/grep.

C1 is the highest-priority finding: the stated validation gate ('re-run adv_doctor until canonical_projection_consistent: true') is unsatisfiable on the pokeedge-class store because adv_doctor has no budget override and budget_exceeded forces consistent=false (doctor.test.ts:156-158).

blocking_findings.fix: Wire an unbounded proof into the apply flow, persist it in the run report, and fail the tool/CLI result when proof is incomplete or errors. Add host/CLI contract tests proving the proof executes and is fail-closed.

blocking_findings.label: blocker
blocking_findings.what: Resume treats failed receipts as completed.
blocking_findings.why: `rebuildProgressFromReceipts` puts every receipt status into `applied`; `runReconcileApply` then skips those record IDs on resume. A failed record therefore can never be retried, contradicting AC9's receipt-sourced resumable progress and completion semantics.
blocking_findings.fix: Only durable successful terminal receipts may advance resume progress; retain failed receipts as residual/retryable and add a failure-then-resume regression test.

blocking_findings.label: blocker
blocking_findings.what: Budgeted/record-capped scans truncate without a persisted continuation cursor or an automatic continuation pass.
blocking_findings.why: A caller can supply `max_records` or `budget_ms`; the scan returns a partial plan (`omitted: 1`) and apply can report success after that subset. This is neither bounded enumeration with persisted resumable scan progress nor a safe completion path, violating AC9/C6.
blocking_findings.fix: Refuse apply from a truncated scan or implement persisted scan continuation that eventually enumerates every record before any completed result.

blocking_findings.label: issue

requirement.body: The store reconcile pass MUST be dry-run-first: the default mode performs classification and planning only, emits a complete typed plan plus a plan_hash (SHA-256 of the canonicalized plan JSON), and writes no store records. An apply-mode invocation MUST require a confirm_plan_hash equal to a prior dry-run's plan_hash and MUST re-verify that hash against a fresh scan before mutating; a mismatch is a typed refusal, never a partial mutation. The dry-run/approval contract MUST be identical on every operator surface (MCP tool and bin/adv CLI).

When an envelope is newer than canonical, the pass MUST report it only and MUST NOT modify the canonical projection. The canonical projection MUST be byte-identical before and after any envelope advancement.

requirement.title: Bounded batches with receipt-sourced resumable progress
requirement.body: The reconcile pass MUST enumerate records in bounded batches and persist resumable progress: an atomic per-record receipt is written as each record completes and a progress checkpoint is persisted after each batch. Receipts are the source of truth for resume; the progress checkpoint is derivable from receipts and MUST be rebuilt from them when corrupt. A re-invocation with resume_from MUST skip records with completed receipts without re-applying their actions. A pass that terminates without a final run report MUST be derivable as interrupted, never synthesized as success.

# Reconcile Temporal→disk migration residue

## Why
The Temporal removal left projection/summary/Epic residue that degrades ADV aggregation (`adv_status` degraded), loses coordination for four Epics (~9 active changes orphaned from their Epic owner records), and surfaced at least one schema-drift corruption. Per-change reads remain functional, but the aggregate consistency and Epic coordination layer are not trustworthy until reconciled — and no exposed command can repair any residue class.

## Root Cause Analysis

**Defect origin:** Temporal removal completed before disk-store reconciliation; residue degrades projection consistency and four Epic owner records were lost from disk.

**Evidence gathered:**

**Leading hypothesis:** migration sequencing defect — Temporal deleted before a reconcile pass existed; the reconcile pass was never built.

**Ruled-out paths:** self-heal via existing tools (doctor, quarantine, launcher-rebuild — verified insufficient individually and in combination); Epic convergence (top-down only); historical-repair (orphan export, wrong reconciliation target).

**Spec-law impact:** change required — new operator-facing reconciliation capability; `adv_spec` search confirms no existing capability covers store reconciliation.

— RCA produced via `/adv-problem` triage (full record in session transcript); no bypass.

## What Changes
Add a **runnable reconciliation pass** (an `adv` CLI subcommand and/or MCP tool, e.g. `adv reconcile` / `adv_reconcile_store`) that wires the existing internal modules into a single idempotent, dry-run-first pass over a project store:

Runs FIRST: summary rebuild depends on canonical parseability.
2. **Summary-shard rebuild** — wire the existing `rebuildSummaryIndex` path (`change-summary-shard.ts:614`, as exercised by `adv_launcher_projection_rebuild`) to rebuild summary shards + pointers from canonical projections for every change with a missing/stale pointer. 3. **Legacy-envelope reconciliation** — new writer (greenfield: none exists): for each "legacy envelope behind/differs" finding, reconcile the legacy flat envelope up to the canonical revision and record the reconciliation (before-state preserved). Canonical is authoritative post-migration; never overwrite canonical with legacy.
4. **Complete pending migrations** — run artifact-metadata migration + session-registry completion beyond the store-init path to clear the `unmigrated` set and set `migration_status`.
5. **Epic backfill** — for each `EPIC_NOT_FOUND` Epic referenced by active-change `epic_membership`, enumerate surviving child fragments (full scan), reconstruct an owner record **only where fragments are sufficient**, stamped `reconstructed: true` with explicit gap flags (missing entries, reconstructed narrative). 6. **Validation gate** — re-run `adv_doctor` until `canonical_projection_consistent: true`; emit before/after divergence counts.

1. An operator can run one command to bring any ADV project store back to a consistent, trustworthy state after an incomplete migration — previewable before any write, safe to re-run.
2. Aggregate views and Epic coordination on the affected store become trustworthy again (doctor consistent, migrations complete).

# Problem Statement

## Incident
The Advance plugin removed its Temporal backing and made on-disk projections the sole authority (`c231b2eb complete Temporal removal`, `05907bbc remove Temporal read paths`, `ab300f93 bypass Temporal signal dispatch`, `0d565876 delete replay-determinism test infrastructure`). The migration completed before all records were reconciled to disk. An affected consumer project (pokeedge) reports `canonical_projection_consistent: false` with divergences beyond doctor's scan budget (64 projections / 1500ms; 225 omitted per firsthand discovery run — more remain), a degraded summary index, legacy-envelope divergence (worst case: canonical rev 99 vs legacy rev 0), `unmigrated: 9` with `migration_status: null`, one quarantined schema-drifted change, and four Epic owner records lost (`strengthenDataModelIntegrity`, `pricingIdentityIntegrity`, `collectionSellTradeMarkers`, `strengthenCrossRepoBrowserConfidence`) — orphaning ~9 active changes whose only surviving Epic evidence is child-side `epic_membership` fragments.

**Prevalence upgrade (discovery, 2026-08-07):** the residue class is NOT pokeedge-specific. The advance repo's own store (`bdf259…`) also reports `migration_status: null` with `auto_managed_changes.unmigrated: 10` (`adv_status view:"health"`). At least two stores are affected; any store written before the removal may carry residue. Additionally, a mid-discovery artifact-phantom incident (agreement writes durable but unreadable by `adv_contract_mint`/`include.agreement`) was root-caused to a stale loaded plugin bundle: the #403 canonical-artifact-reader fix (commit `29252461`) deployed at 19:59:47Z, after the session's plugin process started (19:13:36Z) — `source_dist_freshness: dist_ahead_of_process`. Phantom resolved by OpenCode restart; it is a deploy-lag incident, not a state defect, but it demonstrates how fragile artifact read paths are when reader/writer versions drift.

## Root Cause Analysis
Temporal was deleted before a reconciliation pass existed, and no reconcile command was ever built. Verified against the codebase: the relevant internal modules (`change-summary-shard.ts`, `artifact-metadata-migration.ts`, `session-registry.ts`, `launcher-projection.ts`) are operation-scoped library code; `adv_doctor` repairs only session pointers and dead worker locks (`tools/doctor.ts:430,367`) with everything else report-only; no legacy→canonical envelope writer exists anywhere (`projection-health.ts:182` is read-only comparison); Epic convergence flows Epic→child only (`epic-convergence.ts`) with no child-fragment→Epic reconstruction path; `reconcileHistoricalArchiveDeltas` is an orphan export reconciling archive-delta/spec baselines, not store envelopes. `adv_launcher_projection_rebuild` does regenerate per-change summary shards from canonical `change.json` before building the aggregate (`tools/launcher-projection.ts:36-49`) — a latent repair path for the summary-pointer class, but unexposed standalone and unable to handle records that fail canonical parse.

## Why this cannot self-heal
No exposed command completes migrations store-wide, reconciles envelopes, normalizes schema drift, or backfills Epics. `bin/adv` is read-only diagnostics. The one schema-drift exemplar (`optimizeArchitectureTestSuite`, retired `evidence_kind` values) was quarantined, not normalized. The pokeedge store has no git tracking and no backups, so restore-first recovery is impossible — reconstruction from disk evidence is the only path.

## Required Outcome
A runnable, idempotent, dry-run-first reconciliation pass that brings the disk store to `canonical_projection_consistent: true`, completes the pending migrations, normalizes schema-drifted records, and either restores the four lost Epics from surviving fragments (with reconstruction provenance + gap flags) or reconciles them as formally lost with dangling memberships cleaned up. Disk evidence (and ADV-store git history, if any) only — Temporal is gone.

## Goals

## Non-Goals

Mirror agreement DONT1–DONT6 and OOS1–OOS5. Explicitly: no changes to `adv_doctor`'s default diagnostic behavior (OOS4 — **no doctor surface is added**); no fabricated Epic content (OOS5/DONT4); no Temporal (DONT1/OOS1); no disk-architecture change (DONT2/OOS2); no consumer-code/state modification from implementation (DONT3/OOS3); no budget-capped scan as completion proof (DONT5); no parallel census/marker definitions (DONT6).

## Architecture

Six components, single implementation in the plugin, two thin surfaces (AC12):

1. **`storage/store-residue-scan.ts`** — read-only classification scan producing a typed `StoreResidueScan`. Named deliberately **not** "census": the migration-marker census remains `computeAutoManagedCensus` as the single definition (DONT6); this scan classifies *residue records*. Every record → exactly one primary `ResidueClass` + `also_matches[]`. The typed scan result is the single source of truth consumed by both the planner and the mutation dispatcher (P38: classification is never re-derived downstream).
2. **`storage/reconcile-plan.ts`** — pure function `Scan → ReconcilePlan`. Per record: `class`, `actions[]` from the bounded action enum (D4), evidence refs. The plan is canonicalized and hashed → **`plan_hash` = SHA-256 of canonical plan JSON** (C5). Dry-run output = plan + `plan_hash`; apply requires `confirm_plan_hash` matching a prior dry-run's hash (approval contract, identical on both surfaces per AC12).
3. **`storage/reconcile-apply.ts`** — mutation dispatcher. **Refuses to run while `worker.lock` is live on the target store** (C2/AC8; mirrors the read-only `probeWorkerLock` guard at `store-cleanup.ts:276`, NOT `reclaimDeadWorkerLock`). Executes actions per record under per-record locks; writes per-record receipts; bounded batches with persisted resumable progress (AC9); continues past per-record failure (`failed++`, recorded, continue). Adds the optimistic Epic `version` re-check around `saveActiveEpicProjection` (which performs none).
4. **`storage/migration-completion.ts`** — artifact-metadata failed-set disposition via a **net-new per-record callable extracted from `migrateArtifactMetadataProjections`** (currently a bounded 1000-cap whole-pass rewriting only `metadata.source`); completion-marker write **gated on failed-set empty** (AC5); `worktree_auto_managed` marker normalization feeding `computeAutoManagedCensus` to zero (SC2).
5. **`storage/parent-projection-reconcile.ts`** — Epic owner-record reconstruction from surviving child `epic_membership` fragments (derive-from-fragment only, AC6), formally-lost report + dangling-membership cleanup when fragments insufficient (AC7).
6. **`storage/reconcile-report.ts`** + **`storage/reconcile-audit.ts`** — typed run report + per-record receipts + JSONL audit (new module on the per-module `acquireFileLock` + `appendFile` pattern) + before-state preservation + the unbounded completion-proof scan (AC10).

### Data and Control Flow

```
resolve target store paths (resolved path keys; target_path per trust rules)
  → probeWorkerLock: live? → apply: typed refusal exit 4 (AC8/C2) / dry-run: allowed, noted in plan
  → residue scan (read-only, bounded batches of ≤50 records,
     progress checkpoint after each batch → .reconcile/runs/<runId>/progress.json)
  → fail-closed check: corrupt migration marker / quarantine manifest → abort before ANY mutation
  → plan (pure) → plan_hash
  → dry-run: emit plan + plan_hash; write nothing except the resumable progress checkpoint
     (checkpoint carries no mutations; dry-run is side-effect-free w.r.t. store records)
  → apply (requires confirm_plan_hash matching an existing dry-run plan):
     re-verify plan_hash against a FRESH scan (stale plan → typed refusal exit 6)
     acquire store reconcile lock (changes/.reconcile.lock via acquireFileLock; stale-detected)
     per record in plan (batch order; resume skips records with completed receipts):
       per-change records → coordinateChangeMutation(changeId)
       epic records → load-modify-save with explicit version re-check (optimistic concurrency)
       execute actions → atomic per-record receipt
       failure → failed++, receipt {status:"failed", error_class}, continue
  → write run report + before/after divergence counts
  → completion proof: findProjectionDivergences with budgetMs: undefined AND maxChanges unset
     → zero divergences or documented whitelisted benign residual set (AC10)
     → proof-scan ERROR (I/O, not divergences): fail-closed, run NOT complete, never synthesized success
  → append JSONL audit events (reconcile-audit.ts)
```

Idempotence is structural (SC4): classification is state-based — reconciled records reclassify healthy and the re-run plan is empty. Resume (AC9): `progress.json` + per-record receipts let a re-invocation skip completed records; **receipts are the source of truth — a corrupt `progress.json` is rebuilt from receipts**, never the reverse.

## Decisions

### D1 — Typed residue scan, single source of truth (not a second census)

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| A (chosen) | One typed `StoreResidueScan` per run; planner and dispatcher consume it; migration state read via `computeAutoManagedCensus` only |
| B | Separate re-derivation inside each repair function |
| C | New parallel migration-census definition |

**Chosen:** A. **Rationale:** P38 — the map the operator approves (dry-run plan) is the map that mutates; C violates DONT6. **LBP:** one pure scan, one typed result. **Reversibility:** high. **Blast radius:** new files only.

### D2 — Locking: `worker.lock` refusal → reconcile lock → per-record locks

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| A (chosen) | Apply refuses outright when `worker.lock` is live (read-only `probeWorkerLock` mirror — detection only, never reclaim); new `changes/.reconcile.lock` via the repo's `acquireFileLock` (custom `wx`-flag lockfile with timestamp+pid-liveness stale detection) serializes concurrent passes; per-change mutations under `coordinateChangeMutation`; Epic writes optimistic via explicit `version` re-check + create-if-absent re-verify |
| B | Single global lock for everything incl. dry-run |
| C | Per-record locks only |

**Chosen:** A. **Rationale:** C2/AC8 hard constraints with a live real-world case; dry-run stays lock-free and side-effect-free. `saveActiveEpicProjection` performs no version check, so reconcile-apply adds it. **LBP:** mirrors `withArchiveProjectionLock`/`probeWorkerLock`; **no new dependencies — `proper-lockfile` is not used**. **Blast radius:** one new lockfile path; existing lock protocols untouched.

### D3 — Dry-run-first with `plan_hash` approval (C5, AC8, AC12)

Dry-run (default on both surfaces) emits the full plan + `plan_hash` (SHA-256 of canonicalized plan JSON) and writes no store records. Apply requires `confirm_plan_hash` equal to a prior dry-run's hash **and** re-verifies the hash against a fresh scan — a stale plan is a typed refusal (exit 6), closing the TOCTOU gap between approval and mutation. The contract is byte-identical on the MCP tool and `bin/adv reconcile` (AC12). **Rationale:** C5's "emitted and approved before any write" made structural; re-verification makes approval binding on current state. **Blast radius:** none when unused (default dry-run).

### D4 — Bounded per-class action enum

`ReconcileActionSchema` = discriminated union keyed on class; "repair" never appears untyped:

| ResidueClass | Allowed actions |
|---|---|
| `schema_drift_retired_enum` | `normalize_enum_mapping` (`evidence_kind` `build_worker`/`replay_determinism` → `\"other\"`, AC1) · `quarantine_record` (no valid mapping, AC2 — aligned with `adv_change_projection_quarantine` semantics/location) |
| `summary_pointer_missing` / `summary_pointer_stale` | `rebuild_summary_shard` (AC3; per-change `publishSummaryForChange` at `change-summary-shard.ts:242`; whole-store tail via `rebuildSummaryIndex:614` when cheaper) |
| `legacy_divergent_behind` | `advance_legacy_to_canonical` (AC4) |
| `legacy_newer_than_canonical` | `report_only` (AC4: canonical never modified) |
| `unmigrated_artifact_metadata` | `migrate_record` (extracted per-record callable) · `classify_terminal_noop` · `quarantine_record` (AC5) |
| `unmigrated_worktree_marker` | `set_marker_auto` · `set_marker_legacy` (SC2) |
| `epic_owner_missing` | `reconstruct_from_child_fragments` (AC6) · `formally_lost_report` + `clear_dangling_membership` (AC7) |
| `quarantined_record` | `normalize_and_restore` (valid mapping; AC11 fixture) · `remain_quarantined_reported` |
| `unknown_store_noise` | `quarantine_to_trash` (non-record entries only) |
| `store_artifact_missing` | `rebuild_from_changes` |

**Ordering is structural (agreement Agent Decision 8):** schema-drift normalization runs FIRST because `rebuildSummaryIndex` fails on records that fail canonical parse. A record counts as **repaired** only when a mutating action from this enum succeeded. **Blast radius:** schema + dispatcher.

### D5 — Multi-class precedence and monotonic per-class counters

One primary class per record by fixed precedence: schema drift > summary pointers > legacy divergence > migration (`artifact_metadata`, `worktree_marker`) > Epic/orphan > quarantine > noise. `also_matches[]` records the rest; follow-on actions allowed; per-class counters increment for the primary class only, monotonic within a run. **Rationale:** no double-counted dedupe inflation. **Blast radius:** scan + report schema.

### D6 — Legacy-envelope advancement, legacy→canonical only (AC4, C1)

Envelope **behind** canonical: rewrite `changes/<changeId>.json` with canonical content mapped into legacy shape, counters set to exactly the canonical revision — never beyond. Envelope **newer** than canonical: `report_only`; canonical is never modified (C1). Before-state: full byte copy to `.reconcile/runs/<runId>/before/<changeId>.legacy.json` + before/after SHA-256 in receipt and audit. Canonical projection byte-identical before and after (tested). **Rejected alternative:** deleting divergent envelopes (changes doctor comparison semantics; deprecation architecture out of scope). Unit test pins direction (proposal risk). **Reversibility:** byte-exact restore from before-state copy.

### D7 — Artifact-metadata migration completion (AC5, SC2)

**Explicit scope:** `migrateArtifactMetadataProjections` today is a bounded whole-pass (`ARTIFACT_METADATA_MIGRATION_MAX_PROJECTIONS = 1000`) rewriting only `metadata.source`; the per-record `migrate_record` callable is **net-new extraction work**, not an existing function. Per failed-set record: `migrate_record` → on persistent failure `classify_terminal_noop` (evidence recorded) or `quarantine_record`. Completion marker (`artifact-metadata-migration-complete.json`, existing `hasCompletionMarker` semantics) written **only when the failed set is empty**; marker payload records per-record dispositions. SC2's `migration_status` surface read path (`status.ts:305-415`, `status-view.ts:246`) confirmed wired at prep. **Rationale:** breaks the permanent incomplete latch without fabricating success. **Blast radius:** migrator module + marker write only.

### D8 — `worktree_auto_managed` marker normalization (SC2, DONT6)

For each change lacking the marker: `true` when worktree-registry evidence exists, else `false`. Written via `coordinateChangeMutation` as metadata-only; revision-counter bump suppressed for marker-only normalization (prevents self-triggered doctor divergence). Post-pass verification reads `computeAutoManagedCensus` (agreement Agent Decision 4) — the only census definition. **Blast radius:** one metadata field per record.

### D9 — Epic owner reconstruction from fragments, convergence-gated (AC6, AC7)

Targets: the 4 `EPIC_NOT_FOUND` Epics referenced by pokeedge active changes (`strengthenDataModelIntegrity`: orders 4, 9–13 surviving → `entries_partial` gap flag). Reconstruction uses **fragment data only** — entry rows from `entry_id`/`order`/`title`/`linked_at`; `progress` recomputed from child states; `created_at`/`updated_at` from min/max `linked_at`; `version: 0`; `narrative` underivable → gap-flagged placeholder. Provenance is an **explicit optional typed field added to `EpicSchema`** — NOT reliance on `.passthrough()` (which tolerates but does not validate shape):

```ts
// types/epics.ts — additive, backward compatible (older records without the field parse fine)
EpicReconstructionSchema = z.object({
  reconstructed: z.literal(true),
  reconstructed_at: z.string(),
  source: z.enum(["child_fragments", "archive_projection"]),
  gap_flags: z.array(z.enum(["narrative", "title", "entries_partial", "progress_estimated"])),
  run_id: z.string(),
})
// EpicSchema gains: reconstruction: EpicReconstructionSchema.optional()
```

Each reconstructed Epic must pass `convergeEpicMembership` (`epic-convergence.ts:135`) against **all referencing children** before it counts as successful (agreement Agent Decision 5); convergence failure → treated as insufficient fragments. Insufficient fragments (AC7): bounded formally-lost report + `clear_dangling_membership` on the affected children, both explicit dry-run-visible plan entries; Epic content is never fabricated (DONT4/OOS5). A "live projection appeared" optimistic-lock skip is recorded as a **documented residual** in the run report (AC2-style), never silent. **Blast radius:** additive schema field + one new module; SC5 safe (the 8 existing Epics untouched).

### D10 — Quarantined-record disposition (AC11)

`optimizeArchitectureTestSuite` class: `quarantined_record`. Where retired values map cleanly, action `normalize_and_restore` — normalize in place with before-state audit, return to the readable set; quarantine location/semantics align with `adv_change_projection_quarantine` (`tool-registry.ts:780`). Where mapping is invalid: `remain_quarantined_reported` (documented residual, AC2). **Rationale:** agreement User Decision 2. **Blast radius:** the quarantined record(s) only.

### D11 — Exactly two surfaces, identical semantics (AC12, OOS4)

1. **MCP tool `adv_store_reconcile`** (new `plugin/src/tools/store-reconcile.ts` → `storeReconcileTools` → `tool-registry.ts` binding per `adv_change_projection_quarantine`/`adv_store_cleanup` precedent at `:780`/`:794` → `AGENT_TOOL_POLICY` at `tool-role-policy.ts:556`, operator/recovery-only → `pnpm run generate:manifests` + `schemas:generate`, both enforced by `pnpm run check`). Args: `mode: "dry_run"|"apply"` (default `dry_run`), `confirm_plan_hash?: string`, `target_path?` + trust confirmations, `resume_from?: runId`.
2. **`bin/adv reconcile`** — thin Bun subcommand (if-chain at `bin/adv:644+`) spawning the plugin CLI entry `dist/reconcile-cli.js` (`--project-root`, `--mode`, `--confirm-plan-hash`, `--json`), rendering its typed JSON. The CLI entry imports the same `storage/reconcile-*` library — one implementation, two surfaces, **identical plan/execute/dry-run/approval semantics** (AC12). Third-binary wiring follows the `dist/mcp-server.js` precedent exactly: new tsup target + build-pipeline integration + `deploy-local.sh` bundle-manifest entry + SHA-256 hash validation.

**Rejected:** doctor-line surface (violates OOS4); duplicating logic in `bin/lib` (P41 clone-instead-of-call); bin→MCP-over-HTTP (daemon not guaranteed); read-only bin surface (fails AC12). **Blast radius:** new tool file, registry/policy lines, bin subcommand + spawn, one build entry + deploy-manifest wiring. No existing surface changes behavior.

### D12 — Crash-truthful, resumable reporting (AC9, failure-handling contract)

Per-record receipts (`.reconcile/runs/<runId>/receipts/<recordId>.json`) written atomically as each record completes; `progress.json` checkpoint after each ≤50-record batch (last completed key + applied digests); run report at pass end. **Receipts are the source of truth; `progress.json` is derivable/rebuildable from receipts** (corrupt checkpoint never blocks resume). Receipts without a final report (or count mismatch) → `interrupted` derivable, never synthesized as success. Resume: `resume_from: <runId>` skips records with completed receipts. Before-state copies for every in-place repair (C4). Audit via new `storage/reconcile-audit.ts` on the per-module `acquireFileLock` + `appendFile` pattern (`snapshot-repair-audit.ts:155` precedent). `.reconcile/` is allowlist-enumerated so future scans don't self-classify it as noise. **Blast radius:** new store artifact dir + one new audit module.

### D13 — Completion proof: unbounded divergence scan (AC10, DONT5)

Post-apply proof calls `findProjectionDivergences` with **both `budgetMs: undefined` AND `maxChanges` unset** (`projection-health.ts:131-135`) — never the doctor tool's 1500ms-budgeted scan (`doctor.ts:26,185`). Report carries before/after divergence counts. Zero divergences, or a documented whitelisted benign residual set, is the only acceptable proof; a proof-scan **error** (I/O failure, not divergences) is fail-closed — the run is not complete and no success is synthesized. **Rationale:** a capped scan can hide exactly the residue this pass exists to clear (DONT5). **Blast radius:** report module + integration test asserting the unbounded path is exercised.

## Design-Derived Criteria

- DC1 (C5/AC8): Dry-run emits plan + stable `plan_hash`, writes zero store records; apply without a matching `confirm_plan_hash` refuses.
- DC2 (SC4): Re-run after successful apply yields an empty plan.
- DC3 (D4): Summary-shard rebuild never executes before schema-drift normalization in any plan containing both classes.
- DC4 (AC4/C1): Envelope-behind advancement sets counters to exactly the canonical revision; canonical bytes identical before/after; before-state copy byte-identical to pre-pass envelope. Envelope-newer yields `report_only` and zero writes to either file.
- DC5 (AC5): Completion marker absent whenever the failed set is non-empty (property test across fixture matrix).
- DC6 (AC6): Reconstructed Epic passes `EpicSchema.parse`, carries a **schema-validated** `reconstruction` block (`reconstructed: true`, `narrative` and where applicable `entries_partial` gap flags), and passes `convergeEpicMembership` against all referencing children.
- DC7 (AC7/DONT4): Insufficient-fragment path emits the formally-lost report + membership-clearing plan entries and writes no Epic content.
- DC8 (AC8/C2): Apply against a store with live `worker.lock` mutates nothing and exits with typed refusal; dry-run on the same store writes no store records.
- DC9 (AC9): Bounded batches proven by fixture; a killed pass resumed via `resume_from` performs zero repeated mutations; corrupt `progress.json` with intact receipts still resumes correctly.
- DC10 (AC10/DONT5): Completion proof exercises `findProjectionDivergences` with `budgetMs` undefined and `maxChanges` unset (test asserts both); a simulated proof-scan error fails the run closed.
- DC11 (AC11): Fixture replicating `optimizeArchitectureTestSuite` (retired `evidence_kind` values) is normalized, restored to the readable set, and validates against the current change schema; before-state audit exists.
- DC12 (AC12): Tool and `bin/adv reconcile` produce identical plan JSON + `plan_hash` for the same target store and both enforce the dry-run/approval contract (spawn-level parity test in `bun test bin/`).

## Interface Contracts

- Tool args/result + `ReconcilePlanSchema`/`ReconcileRunReportSchema` in `schema-registry.ts` (generated; `schemas:check` enforced). Plan: `{ schema_version, run_id, target_store, created_at, records: [{ id, class, also_matches[], actions[], evidence[] }], counters: Record<ResidueClass, number>, plan_hash }`. Report: `{ schema_version, run_id, mode, started_at, finished_at|null, interrupted, records: [{ id, class, actions[], status, reasons[], before_hash?, after_hash? }], counters: { mutated, skipped, failed }, residuals: [{ id, class, reason }], proof: { divergences_before, divergences_after, whitelisted_residuals[], scan_error?: string } }`.
- Receipt: `{ record_id, class, action, status, error_class?, before_hash?, after_hash?, ts }`. Progress checkpoint: `{ run_id, last_completed_key, applied: string[], ts }` (derivable from receipts).
- Audit JSONL event (via `reconcile-audit.ts`, `acquireFileLock` + `appendFile`): `{ event: "store_reconcile", run_id, record_id, class, action, before_hash?, after_hash?, ts }`.
- `dist/reconcile-cli.js`: `--project-root <path> --mode dry-run|apply [--confirm-plan-hash <sha>] [--resume-from <runId>] --json`; exit codes 0 ok / 2 usage (incl. target-store resolution failure) / 3 aborted-corrupt-input / 4 lock-or-worker-lock-refusal / 5 partial-failure (incl. disk-full) / 6 stale-plan.

## Failure Modes and Recovery

| Failure | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Live `worker.lock` (apply) | Typed refusal, exit 4, zero mutation (AC8/C2; `probeWorkerLock` read-only probe) |
| Stale `plan_hash` at apply | Typed refusal, exit 6; operator re-runs dry-run |
| Concurrent reconcile pass | Reconcile-lock contention → typed error, exit 4 |
| Concurrent other mutator (`adv_store_cleanup`, archive ops) | Per-change `coordinateChangeMutation` serialization + Epic optimistic version + plan_hash re-verification bound the window; residual races surface as per-record `failed` receipts |
| Corrupt migration marker / quarantine manifest | Abort before any mutation, typed error (fail-closed) |
| Epic `version` race / live projection appeared | Re-load, re-verify create-if-absent; skip recorded as documented residual in run report |
| Crash mid-record | Atomic write semantics — pre- or post-, never torn; receipt absence ⇒ resume reclassifies |
| Crash between receipts/batches | `interrupted` derivable (D12); `resume_from` completes remainder (DC9) |
| Corrupt `progress.json`, receipts intact | Checkpoint rebuilt from receipts (receipts are source of truth); resume proceeds |
| Per-record action failure | `failed++`, receipt with error class, continue; documented residual |
| `convergeEpicMembership` failure post-reconstruction | Treat as insufficient fragments → AC7 path |
| Completion-proof scan error (I/O) | Fail-closed: run not complete, `proof.scan_error` recorded, no success synthesized (DC10) |
| Target-store resolution failure / disk-full | Typed exit 2 / 5; zero partial mutation beyond already-receipted records |

## Security and Privacy

Store-local filesystem only; no network. Trash/quarantine moves preserve content; nothing is permanently deleted — the most destructive action is a move to quarantine/trash with before-state copies. `target_path` follows existing cross-project trust rules (explicit confirmation required). Plans/reports reference records by id + class only; no note/proposal body text is echoed into any artifact.

## Test and Validation Plan

Unit (Vitest, `plugin/src/**`): scan classification matrix (one fixture per class + multi-class precedence + `.reconcile/` self-exclusion); plan purity + `plan_hash` stability/canonicalization; per-action dispatcher with mocked locks; D6 direction test (behind→advance exact revision; newer→report-only; canonical byte-identical); D7 marker gating property (DC5) + extraction unit tests for the per-record `migrate_record`; D8 marker inference + no revision bump; D9 EpicSchema round-trip (with/without `reconstruction`), gap-flag validation, convergence gate, AC7 no-fabrication; D10 normalize+restore fixture (DC11); D12 interrupted-derivation + resume-skip + corrupt-checkpoint rebuild; fail-closed corrupt-input abort; proof-scan-error fail-closed (DC10).
Integration: temp-store fixture replicating the verified pokeedge shape (retired-enum record, missing/stale summary pointers, envelope behind + envelope newer, unmigrated metadata + marker census, 2 reconstructable + 1 underivable `EPIC_NOT_FOUND` Epics, quarantined-with-valid-mapping record, noise, live/absent `worker.lock` variants) → dry-run zero-write + `plan_hash` (DC1) → apply → unbounded divergence proof zero/whitelisted (DC10) → re-run empty plan (DC2) → killed-pass resume (DC9) → worker.lock refusal (DC8).
Bin: `bun test bin/` — spawn-level parity test: bin vs tool emit identical plan + `plan_hash` (DC12); exit-code matrix.
Isolation: `createTempDir`/`XDG_DATA_HOME` per the repo isolation checker; consumer store never touched by tests (DONT3).

## Observability

JSONL audit per mutated record (`reconcile-audit.ts`); run report + receipts + progress checkpoints durable under `.reconcile/runs/`; before/after divergence counts in every apply report; documented residuals list. Bounded display: record refs capped at 10, verbatim, `[+N more]`.

## Dependencies and Assumptions

**No new runtime dependencies** — locking via the repo's `acquireFileLock` (`utils/fs.ts:185`), Zod, fs. Assumes: per-record `migrate_record` extraction from `migrateArtifactMetadataProjections` is feasible (bounded 1000-cap whole-pass today; extraction is scoped work); `convergeEpicMembership` callable per-Epic (verified `epic-convergence.ts:135`); `findProjectionDivergences` accepts unset `budgetMs`/`maxChanges` (verified `projection-health.ts:131-135`); `migration_status` read wiring (`status.ts:305-415`, `status-view.ts:246`) confirmed at prep.

## Rollout and Migration

Ship tool + CLI entry together (incl. tsup target + `deploy-local.sh` bundle-manifest wiring). Proving case (agreement Objective 5): operator runs `bin/adv reconcile --project-root <pokeedge store>` (or the tool with `target_path`) → dry-run + `plan_hash` review → apply with `confirm_plan_hash` → SC1–SC5 verified on the consumer store. Implementation and tests never touch the consumer store (DONT3). Docs: tool description, `bin/adv --help`. No backfill; read paths unchanged.

## Alternatives Considered

- **`reconcileHistoricalArchiveDeltas` as the reconcile engine** — closest existing precedent (dry-run/apply + projection-lock shape, `archive/historical-repair.ts:511`) but an orphan export targeting archive-delta residue, not active-store migration residue; design adopts its *shape*, not its code path.
- **`adv_launcher_projection_rebuild` for AC3** — existing whole-store operator surface; design reuses its library functions (`publishSummaryForChange`/`rebuildSummaryIndex`) as per-record actions inside the plan instead of a separate whole-store invocation, keeping one plan/approval/audit envelope (P41, no duplicate UX).
- **`adv_change_projection_quarantine` for AC2/AC11** — existing operator quarantine surface; design aligns quarantine semantics/location with it rather than inventing a second quarantine mechanism.
- **Doctor-line / doctor-embedded surface** — rejected (D11): OOS4.
- **Delete divergent legacy envelopes** — rejected (D6): doctor comparison semantics; deprecation out of scope.
- **Duplicate reconcile logic in `bin/lib`** — rejected (D11): P41 clone-instead-of-call.
- **bin/adv calls MCP over HTTP** — rejected (D11): daemon availability not guaranteed.
- **`terminal_auto` permanent-deletion mode** — rejected: not in the approved agreement (artifact of the confabulated summary); most destructive action is a content-preserving move.
- **Auto-run from status/health reads** — rejected: mutation on a read path.
- **Extend `adv_doctor` with repair actions** — rejected (agreement Agent Decision 1): diagnosis/repair separation.
- **Restore-first from pokeedge backups** — operator decision at run time, not an implementation blocker.

# Executive Summary — Reconcile store migration residue

## Outcome
The ADV store now has a safe, operator-driven reconciliation pass that detects and repairs the persistent residue left behind by earlier store migrations. The pass is dry-run-first: it scans the store, emits a complete typed repair plan with an approval hash, and mutates nothing until the operator approves that exact plan. It is available both as an MCP tool (`adv_store_reconcile`) and as a standalone CLI (`bin/adv reconcile`) with identical semantics on both surfaces.

## What it repairs
- Change records carrying retired schema values are normalized back to schema-valid, with before-state preserved in audit records (unmappable records are quarantined and reported, never synthesized).
- Missing or stale summary-index pointers are rebuilt from canonical change records.
- Lagging legacy envelopes advance to the canonical revision (legacy→canonical direction only; newer-than-canonical is report-only, canonical never modified).
- Incomplete artifact-metadata migrations are completed; the completion marker is written only when the failed set is empty.
- Missing Epic owner records are reconstructed from surviving child membership fragments with explicit provenance and gap flags; insufficient fragments produce a formal-loss report and explicit membership cleanup — never fabricated Epic content.
- Quarantined (corrupt) records are normalized and restored where their values map cleanly.
- Unknown store noise is moved to trash, with an explicit allowlist.

## Safety properties (independently reviewed)
- Dry-run-first with plan-hash approval on every surface; stale plans are typed refusals with zero mutations.
- A live worker lock refuses apply-mode mutation (read-only probe; the lock is never reclaimed or modified).
- Bounded batches with atomic per-record receipts; an interrupted run is derivable as interrupted, never synthesized as success. Resume continues from receipts — only durably-completed records are skipped.
- Completion proof is an unbounded full-scan divergence check with before/after counts; a proof error fails closed (the run is recorded as not complete).

## Verification
- Full repository suite: 5,166 tests green, including a pokeedge-shaped integration fixture that drives the real scan → plan → dry-run → approve → apply → receipts → audit → proof pipeline against all twelve residue classes.
- CLI parity suite: 374 bun tests green; build emits the third bundle (`dist/reconcile-cli.js`) with hash-validated deploy wiring.
- Independent acceptance review: verdict READY, no findings, with a recorded AC1–AC12 / SC1–SC5 coverage table.
- The integration suite and two review rounds caught seven real defects before release (schema-invalid projection commit path, nested quarantine resolution, Epic provenance loss, multi-class overlap residue, orphaned completion proof, failed-receipt resume skips, bounded-page pre-execution refusal); all were repaired at the mechanism level with regression tests.

## Release Readiness Summary (harden phase)
- **Verdict**: READY (independent hardening reviewer), with four hardening fixes applied and re-verified before sign-off: completion-proof baselines are now captured under the reconcile lock, quarantine restore refuses target overwrites, lint/format clean, integration assertions strengthened.
- **Ops readiness**: `pnpm run check`, `pnpm run build` (all three bundles + hash-validated manifest), and the full suite (5,166 tests) pass on the release branch. Deploy wiring carries the new CLI bundle; per policy, deployment runs only from the merged default branch — never from the worktree.
- **Migration/data impact**: the pass mutates operator stores only after explicit plan-hash approval; every mutation class preserves before-state bytes or audit records; canonical projections are byte-identical across legacy-envelope advancement; quarantined and formally-lost records are reported, never fabricated.
- **Collision/release risk**: peer hot changes share `tool-registry.ts` / `tool-role-policy.ts`; merge-order conflict possible but mechanical to resolve. The new tool is additive and operator-only; the CLI bundle is additive; no existing surface changed behavior.
- **Open follow-ups (non-blocking)**: first production run against the pokeedge store should be an operator-reviewed dry-run; reconstructed Epics intentionally carry narrative/metadata gap flags for later hand-fill; unmappable quarantined records remain quarantined as documented residuals.

## Risks and follow-ups
- The pass has not yet been run against the production pokeedge store; the first real run should be a dry-run reviewed by the operator before approval (the tool enforces this).
- Epic reconstruction intentionally leaves narrative/metadata as flagged gaps; operators may want to hand-fill reconstructed Epic narratives afterward.
- Remaining quarantined records that cannot be normalized stay quarantined and are reported as documented residuals in the run report.
